destinations.description: Summit Air office staff, during business hours only. Use only when the call-start context allows a live transfer and the caller wants a person or the situation needs one, after telling the caller you're connecting them.
destinations.message: Connecting you with our team now. Please stay on the line.

fallbackPlan.message: I wasn't able to reach anyone just now. I can take a callback request for our office, or keep helping you here.

messages.content: The transfer failed and nobody was reached. Nothing has been recorded yet, so do not say a callback was noted or requested. Tell the caller you couldn't reach anyone, then offer to record a callback request with request_followup (reason caller_requested) or to keep helping them yourself.
